public.text: The section advises countries not to implement the full scope at once but does not yet state the criteria for prioritising one foundational component over another.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce prioritisation criteria such as urgency of the selected use cases, dependency centrality, existing maturity, data quality, governance readiness, implementation cost, equity impact, and expected cross-programme reuse.
